request_windows_assign_rule: assigned by CSV Start Time(us) (host wall epoch us) within sent_wall_ns/1000 .. received_wall_ns/1000; monotonic not used for assignment

delta_row_type_counts.note: CSV row counts are profiler event tallies within each request wall window, not full executed layer/kernel totals; varying counts do not by themselves imply model layer skipping or loss.

union_semantics_note: clipped_interval_union_dur_us is the merged coverage of these profiler CSV intervals clipped to the request wall window; summed durations may overlap. Union is not hardware utilization and not a full wall-time decomposition.
limitations: Only rank0 NPU profiler kernel_details.csv events are analyzed, not the 482MB trace_view.json.

CSV row counts are profiler-event tallies within request windows, not authoritative executed layer/kernel totals; differing counts across requests do not by themselves indicate model skipping or loss.
clipped_interval_union_dur_us only measures coverage of the profiled CSV intervals; summed durations may overlap, so union is not hardware utilization or a complete wall-time decomposition.
Shapes/dtypes are reported as observed in the profiler; no causal or correctness verdict is made.
Time bases: CSV Start Time(us) is host wall epoch microseconds; request/timeline wall offsets were checked for consistency (see offset_check_per_request) and reported as-is.
No benchmark performance gains or model correctness claims are made in this report.
